# harbour_certificate_import (Resource)

Registers a certificate that already lives in ACM (imported by some other means) for Harbour lifecycle tracking — renewal, alerting, and revocation — without Harbour ever holding or needing the private key. The ARN's ACM Type must be IMPORTED; AMAZON_ISSUED certificates can't be adopted this way. No cert material changes at registration time — the existing ACM object is left untouched until the ordinary renewal-window scan reissues it through Harbour's CA, same as any harbour_certificate with export_to_acm. Destroying this resource revokes the registration; until the first renewal happens, that can only delete the ACM object (acm_only), since Harbour never signed this certificate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Registers a certificate that already lives in ACM (however it got there —
# a previous harbour_certificate with export_to_acm = true, a migration off
# another CA, or anything else) for Harbour lifecycle tracking. Requires the
# same cross-account IAM role as ACM export, plus acm:DescribeCertificate and
# acm:GetCertificate. Its ACM Type must be IMPORTED — an AMAZON_ISSUED cert
# can't be registered this way. No cert material changes at registration —
# the ARN is untouched until Harbour's normal renewal window reissues it.
resource "harbour_certificate_import" "existing" {
  acm_certificate_arn = "arn:aws:acm:eu-west-1:123456789012:certificate/abc-123"
  auto_renew          = true
}

output "cn" {
  description = "Common name read from the existing ACM certificate"
  value       = harbour_certificate_import.existing.cn
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `acm_certificate_arn` (String) ARN of an existing ACM certificate in your account (Type must be IMPORTED) to register with Harbour.

### Optional

- `auto_renew` (Boolean) Whether Harbour proactively renews this certificate ahead of expiry. Defaults to the tenant's default_auto_renew config value when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `cn` (String) Common name, read from the ACM certificate's DomainName.
- `expiry_timestamp` (Number) Certificate expiry as a Unix timestamp, read from the ACM certificate at registration time.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `issuance_method` (String) Always "imported" for this resource.
- `request_id` (String)
- `sans` (List of String) Subject alternative names, read from the ACM certificate.
- `secret_arn` (String) Null until this certificate's first Harbour-managed renewal, same reasoning as serial_number.
- `serial_number` (String) Null until this certificate's first Harbour-managed renewal — Harbour never signed the originally-imported material, so there's no CA-side serial for it.
- `status` (String) Current certificate status (issued, renewing, revoked, expired).
